sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's digital economy is structurally accelerating on 200M+ internet users and a young demographic, driving sustained local tech revenue growth independent of US cycles.
Semiconductor demand is a durable global tailwind, with Korean memory giants (000660, 005930) signaling a multi-year upcycle that benefits Indonesian downstream assemblers and distributors.
Government push for local data sovereignty and cloud adoption creates a protected moat for domestic tech platforms, insulating them from foreign competition and boosting valuation multiples.
sectors.ai: Buy Indonesian tech exposure now: the sector's +1.85% local outperformance vs +0.61% US confirms domestic catalysts are firing, led by semiconductor and e-commerce names. Ride the momentum in IRSX and PMUI, but rotate into large-cap liquid plays like MLPT for safety. Trim AMZN and 9984 as US tech lags; reallocate to ID-listed proxies. Expect 10-15% upside in 90 days as foreign flows accelerate post-alert.
